INSERT INTO ISSUE_COMMENT ( COMMENT_ID, ISSUE_ID, MEMBER_ID, CONTENT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{commentId}, #{issueId}, #{memberId}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT C.COMMENT_ID, C.ISSUE_ID, C.MEMBER_ID, M.NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, M.LOGIN_ID AS MEMBER_LOGIN_ID, C.CONTENT, C.CREATED_AT, C.UPDATED_AT, C.DELETED_AT, C.DELETED_BY FROM ISSUE_COMMENT C INNER JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = C.MEMBER_ID WHERE C.ISSUE_ID = #{issueId} AND C.DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT ASC, C.COMMENT_ID ASC
